name: Linger
tagline: Keep visual references, original links, and notes in a local Mac library.
description:
Linger is a local-first image organizer for designers and other people who collect visual references. It keeps source links and notes with saved images, so it is easier to remember why a reference mattered and to return to its original context.

The app can bring saved images together on a project canvas. Use text, tags, or a remembered color to find a reference again without needing its filename.

## Features
- Save images and screenshots with their original links and your own notes.
- Keep a managed library on your Mac and leave original Finder files in place.
- Search by saved text, tags, or color, and arrange references on a canvas.

## Where it fits
Linger is for individuals building a private reference library for creative work. Each Mac has a separate library, so projects that need shared folders or team editing need a different collaboration workflow.

## Privacy and requirements
The developer describes the library as local to your Mac, with no built-in cloud sync. The app requires macOS 14 or later and Apple Silicon. The seven-day full trial starts without signing in or providing payment details. Optional email sign-in adds 23 days, for 30 days total. The library works offline after activation.

## Pricing
To keep adding references after the trial, Linger requires a one-time purchase. Existing references, notes and source links remain accessible, with basic search and export. The Personal and Lifetime licenses have regular prices of US$39 and US$79, respectively. The official pricing page lists current offers.
